_comment_purpose: Template config for cc-plugin-custom-device on this WRX80 Creator R2.0 workstation. Copied to /etc/coolercontrol/plugins/custom-device/config.json by 'ujust install-cc-plugin' (skip-if-exists; safe to edit in place via UI or editor). After edits: sudo systemctl restart coolercontrold.
_comment_mapping: Channels 1-5 → CPU_FAN1, CPU_FAN2/WP (rear), CHA_FAN1/WP (bottom hub), CHA_FAN2/WP (top front), CHA_FAN3/WP (bottom front). FAN6 (SB_FAN1) and FAN7 (MOS_FAN1) intentionally not exposed; they stay on BMC auto curves.
_comment_temps: Temperature commands output millidegrees Celsius (CoolerControl's expected unit; awk *1000 converts).

commands.get_rpm: ipmitool sensor get CPU_FAN1 | awk '/Sensor Reading/{print $4}'

temps.label: CPU
temps.command: ipmitool sensor get TEMP_CPU | awk '/Sensor Reading/{print $4*1000}'

temps.label: VRM
temps.command: ipmitool sensor get TEMP_VRM | awk '/Sensor Reading/{print $4*1000}'
